mainEntity.name: Who founded Flipick and where is it based?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick is a learning-technology company founded in 2011 by Ravi Dugal. It is based in Pune, India.

Flipick builds an AI video platform that creates studio-grade video, distributes it personally to every viewer and proves it landed. It also offers Flipick LMS, an AI skills-development platform, and a PowerPoint-to-SCORM course conversion service.
Flipick serves 150,000+ active learners across enterprise clients including Pearson, IIBF, Godrej, Jindal Steel, IFC World Bank Group and IICA.
Email sales@flipick.com for sales or support@flipick.com for support, or book a demo from this page. The Pune office is staffed Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00 IST.
